title: Mixed audiences and the second balcony
summary: Black patrons sat in the second balcony, leading Welburn to mention 'Second Balcony Jump'.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: The Palm Beach Hotel. At places that the Oliver band played on the tours, what kind of audience did you have? Was it a mixed audience, or was it say a Colored audience...?

Well, at some places we played it was a mixed audience. But mostly Colored people at... We would sit in the... Not we, but our people(?) used to come in and sit in the back, or either... Some big dance hall or another had what you call a second balcony. Our people had to sit on the second floor. The White people sat in the front, on a level floor...
I see. So that sort of leads us to that tune of "Second Balcony Jump."
